description: Mounted on a pylon in Woodhaven Park on Portage Avenue, at the 500 Wing RCAF Association building. Long displayed in Golden Centennaires colours; refurbished and returned to the park in 2019 and reported since repainted in Red Knight colours. Earlier RCAF serial 21232.
